obligations.source_text: Keep the complete specimen boundary, parent fluid, multiple nuclei, and advancing interface simultaneously readable.

bindings.specimen_phrase: one material specimen has a complete readable boundary that owns every phase region inside the transparent cylindrical quartz ampoule
bindings.gradient_phrase: a temperature pressure field or concentration gradient acts coherently across that same specimen from frosted copper cooling clamp to warm ceramic ring
bindings.parent_phrase: the original parent phase remains materially legible around the emerging regions as translucent amber fluid around pale crystals
bindings.nuclei_phrase: multiple distinct nuclei of a new phase form inside the parent material rather than as surface decoration throughout the fluid as separated pale crystal islands
bindings.interface_phrase: a continuous advancing interface keeps parent and new phases simultaneously visible inside one specimen along the cold-to-warm axis
